{{Quote|Hmmmm.... that holovid was most disturbing. Considering most of it was touched up by their propagandists, there was still enough to unsettle me. I need you to do one more thing for me. '''Jaaves''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] servant for [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Jatrian Lytus]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Jaaves]]
Jaaves was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Jaaves spawned under the generic "bodyguard" template, his appearance was randomized under one of thirty-five possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Jaaves could appear as included [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] under either gender. The [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Jaaves as male, however the [[canon]]ical species cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
